issues.comment: Incorrect spelling of the adverb of time
Missing apostrophe in the negative auxiliary verb
Incorrect combination of auxiliary verb and past tense main verb

issues.quote: yesturday i was going to the shop
issues.comment: Imprecise progressive form for a completed past action
issues.correction: Yesterday I was going to the shop

issues.quote: so i dont wanted to walk anymore
issues.correction: so I did not want to walk anymore

issues.quote: but my friend sayed its fine and we go anyways.
issues.correction: but my friend said it was fine and we went anyway.

issues.quote: the street was slippy and we almost falled but it was kinda funny tho.
issues.comment: Run-on sentence joining contrasting ideas without proper punctuation
issues.correction: The street was slippery, and we almost fell, but it was rather funny, though.

issues.comment: Nonstandard informal variant of the adverb

issues.quote: yesturday i was going to the shop but then the rain was like super heavy so i dont wanted to walk anymore but my friend sayed its fine and we go anyways. the street was slippy and we almost falled but it was kinda funny tho.
issues.comment: Does not follow the instruction to use clear and formal English
issues.correction: Yesterday I intended to go to the shop, but the rain became very heavy, so I did not want to walk any further. However, my friend said it was acceptable and we went anyway. The street was slippery, and we almost fell, but it was rather amusing, though.

issues.quote: but then the rain was like super heavy
issues.comment: Informal phrasing reduces clarity and formality
issues.correction: but then the rain became very heavy

issues.quote: the street was slippy and we almost falled but it was kinda funny tho.
issues.comment: Contrast between danger and humour is not clearly signalled in a formal manner
issues.correction: The street was slippery, and we almost fell, but we still found it rather funny.
